descriptionHtml:
Transcend StoreJet 25M3 2TB External Hard Drive

Protect your essential data on the move with the high-durability Transcend StoreJet 25M3 2TB portable external hard drive, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Combining elite military-grade shockproof protection with the high-speed connectivity of the USB 3.1 Gen 1 interface, this external drive offers rapid file transfer rates along with top-tier physical defense against accidental drops and impacts. Featuring a premium three-stage shock protection system incorporating a vibration-absorbing silicone outer shell, a reinforced rigid casing, and an internal hard drive suspension damper, your files stay safe in any environment. Equipped with an incredibly convenient One-Touch Auto-Backup button and full AES 256-bit encryption support via Transcend Elite software, managing and securing your massive storage library is completely effortless. This reliable portable storage solution comes backed by a 1-year warranty setup.

Detailed Specifications

  • Capacity: 2 TB

  • Form Factor: 2.5 Inch

  • Storage Media: SATA HDD (Internal spin speed typically 5400 RPM)

  • Connection Interface: USB 3.1 Gen 1 (USB 3.0 compatible)

  • Data Transfer Speed: Up to 5 Gbps (Interface bandwidth)

  • Actual Transfer Performance: ~130 MB/s Sequential Read/Write

  • USB Type: Micro-USB to USB Type-A cable

  • Anti-Shock System: 3-Stage Shock Protection

    • Outer durable silicone rubber shell

    • Reinforced hard casing

    • Internal shock-absorbing suspension damper

  • Shock Resistance Standard: MIL-STD-810G 516.6 (U.S. Military transit drop-test compliant in non-operating state)

  • Special Hardware Features: One-Touch Auto-Backup button

  • Power Supply: DC 5V (Bus-powered via USB, no external power required)

  • Dimensions: 129.5 mm x 80.8 mm x 16.1 mm (5.10" x 3.18" x 0.63")

  • Weight: 185 g (6.53 oz)

  • Operating Temperature: 5°C (41°F) ~ 55°C (131°F)

  • Supported Software features: AES 256-bit file & folder encryption (via Transcend Elite software)
